purpose: Record the physical split preflight for the help and doctor command families before any files are moved out of the shared command package.
policy: This preflight does not authorize a broad command package split. The next physical action may move only the help family in a dedicated commit after all listed gates pass; doctor remains deferred until the help split is validated.
preflightContracts: help remains reachable through root help dispatch and command-specific help routing
help output stays stdout-only through the command output adapter
doctor remains reachable through root command dispatch
doctor --json stays stdout-only with stable nextActions fields
bug --json supportBundle remains available for doctor remediation guidance
no command files move during this preflight

physicalSplitAdmission.nextAllowedAction: Move only the help family in a dedicated P22-12 commit, preserving help output, topic aliases, docs-check coverage, and command registration.
physicalSplitAdmission.blockedAction: Do not move doctor, shared helpers, root wiring, JSON helpers, or output helpers in the help split commit.
physicalSplitAdmission.rollbackRequirement: Restore all help files to cmd/gofly/internal/command in one commit if help output, topic routing, docs-check, command registration, stdout, or stderr behavior changes.
